notes: All libraries are biotin-streptavidin pulldowns of probe-crosslinked RNA from extracted RNA (assay IP_or_pulldown, flag for exclusion). The probe/DMSO was applied to RNA extracts in vitro, not to cells, so treatment none for all; is_control follows the submitters (DMSO = control). Strain CS1562 genotype listed (rpoS amber, tolC::Tn10) -> multiple; strain_group not stated. OD600 0.8 in LB -> no phase.

base_medium.q: cultured at 37 °C in liquid Luria Broth (LB) medium

treatment.q: Isolated RNA was used to incubate TMP photoaffinity probe or DMSO in folding buffer

inducer_added.q: Transcriptome-wide profiling of interactions of the TMP photoaffinity probe with E. Coli RNA extracts

assay_class.q: RNA was isolated after biotin-streptavidin bead pulldown using 50 mM DTT
